First time visit
Sep 2024 • Family
Took wife and son for dinner. The chips and Salsa were good as was most of the food. The distribution of the food was poor as it is not together and my wife had to wait some time for her selections after ours were consumed.
We ordered the 'Jug' of strawberry margaritas. Calling it a Jug is a reach. Not quite 4 small glasses with lots of ice and some kind of strawberry mix. Not worth the price. Note to 5% surcharge on the cover of the menu. A growing trend in Vietnam. Doubt we will return

Must visit Mexican gem
Mar 2023 • Couples
You simply have to go to this wonderful Mexican restaurant. I had the fish tacos which were a delight, fresh and tangy and yummy. We found it a little hard to find as grab driver set us down on other side of street. It’s almost on the junction, small sign outside. Go up to second floor. Believe me, it is worth it. One of the best meals of our six week trip.

Not consistent
Aug 2022 • Friends

Guacamole and chips was nearly $7 and guacamole was less than half an avocado. Ordered specific requirements in food, none was met and the apology given was “we forgot”. The restaurant wasn’t even busy! Never going back again.

Place for friends!
May 2021 • Friends
Wonderful fooddddd! I was so in love with all the dishes from Carlos. He is the best Mexican Chef. Cozy restaurant on 2nd floor, quiet hidden but you will feel very comfortable with theme music, chit chat with friends. The service quiet good and friendly. If you are looking for a place to enjoy with friends and chill out on weekend, this is it. A reservation is recommended as they are usually full house. They close on Monday as well!
